z-k-01-01.title: Fi'iin ajaja wajjin simataa?
z-k-01-01.topic: Nyaata ajajuu: jechoota lakkaa'uu fi gatii
z-k-01-01.goal: Haasaa ajajaa gabaabaa menu wajjin mirkaneessi, sarara hanga isaa menu wajjin hin simanne isa jalqabaa argi, ajajoota baajata murtaa'e wajjin simatan kee ofii tolchi.
z-k-01-01.material:
Kaafeen xiqqoon menu kana qaba (원 = won, maallaqa Koreaa).
커피 한 잔: 3,000원
빵 한 개: 2,000원

손님 = maamila, 직원 = hojjetaa. Haasaa dubbisi.

손님: 커피 두 잔 주세요.
직원: 네. 커피 두 잔, 6,000원이에요.
손님: 그리고 빵 세 개 주세요.
직원: 네. 빵 세 개, 5,000원이에요.
직원: 모두 11,000원이에요.
z-k-01-01.thinking.1: Dogoggora eessarraa jalqabu fi maal darbu argachuu
z-k-01-01.thinking.2: Ajajoota garaagara daangaa wal fakkaatu wajjin simatan baayyee oomishuu
z-k-01-01.prereq.1: Jechoota lakkaa'uu 한, 두, 세, 다섯 ... 개 fi 잔 wajjin beeka
z-k-01-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarara hanga isaa menu wajjin hin simanne isa JALQABAA kam?
z-k-01-01.s.s1.hint.0: Meeshaa tokko tokko fudhadhu: gatii isaa menu irratti argi, ergasii hanga hojjetaan jedhe wajjin wal bira qabi.
z-k-01-01.s.s1.hint.1: Duraan sarara 커피 ilaali akka sarara sirriin maal fakkaatu argitee, ergasii sarara 빵 akkasuma ilaali.
z-k-01-01.s.s1.explain: Sararri 4 dogoggora jalqabaa dha: 빵 tokkoon 2,000원, kanaaf daabboon sadii 6,000원 dha, 5,000원 miti. Sararri 2 gaarii dha (kofii lama 3,000원). Sararri 5 sarara 2 fi sarara 4 sirriitti walitti dabala, garuu hanga daabboo dogoggoraa irraa jalqaba, kanaaf isa illee dogoggora; dogoggora adda miti.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.prompt: Maamilli hanga sarara dhumaa keessa jiru kaffala. Sararri dhumaa hojjetaa maal jechuu qaba ture?
z-k-01-01.s.s2.hint.0: Hanga sirrii meeshaa tokko tokkoon adda baasii herregi.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ergasii waliigala 11,000원 fi'a irra jiru wajjin wal bira qabi.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.a: 세 개 akka 두 개 dubbistee ta'uu dandeessa. Lakkoofsa maamilli jedhe fi lakkoofsa ati fayyadamte wal bira qabi.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.b: Kun hanga hojjetaan mataan isaa jedhe irra deebi'a. Waliigalli gaarii dha, garuu hanga irraa ijaaramu keessaa tokko gaarii miti.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.c: Kun duraan meeshaa hundaa menu wajjin qorachuu, ergasii qofa hanga walitti qabuu irraa dhufa.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.explain: Kofii 2 x 3,000 = 6,000 fi daabboon 3 x 2,000 = 6,000, kanaaf waliigalli 12,000원 dha. 11,000원 hojjetaa waliigala sirrii hanga daabboo dogoggoraa irraati.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.prompt: Sirriitti 13,000원 qabda, hunda isaa 커피 (c kuubbaa) fi 빵 (b ida'amaa) irratti baasuu barbaadda. Gosa hundaa yoo xiqqaate tokko ajaji, waliigalaan meeshaa 6 irraa hin caalin. Ajaja garaagara lama argi.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.hint.0: Duraan kofiin meeqa akka ta'u filadhu, ergasii daabboof maallaqni hangam hafe ilaali.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.hint.1: Maallaqni hafe baay'ina 2,000 yoo hin ta'in, lakkoofsa kofii jijjiiri.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Lakkoofsa guutuu, gosa hundaa yoo xiqqaate tokko.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Lakkoofsa guutuu fayyadami, kuubbaa yoo xiqqaate tokko fi ida'amaa tokko.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.explain: Ajajoonni lama hojjetu: 커피 1 + 빵 5 (3,000 + 10,000) fi 커피 3 + 빵 2 (9,000 + 4,000). 커피 2 wajjin fi'iin 12,000원 dha, 커피 5 immoo 빵 tokko wajjin 13,000 caala.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.prompt: Ajaja kee tokko Afaan Koriyaatiin hojjettootaaf jedhi. Meeshaalee lamaanuu, jechoota lakkaa'uu isaanii, fi 주세요 fayyadami.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.hint.0: Dura kutaa buna jedhi, ergasii kutaa daabboo, fi 주세요 tiin xumuri.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.hint.1: Buna 잔 tiin fi daabboo 개 tiin lakkaa'i.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ajajni koo lakkoofsa ajaja koo lamaan tarkaanfii duraa keessaa tokko fayyadamaa?
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: 커피 잔 waliin fi 빵 개 waliin deemaa?
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Hojjetaan maal fiduu akka qabu sirriitti beekuu danda'aa?
z-k-01-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Meeshaalee lamaan walitti hiduuf 하고 fayyadama.

z-k-01-02.thinking.1: Xumura haaraa yeroo odeeffannoon haaraan dhufu sirreessuu
z-k-01-02.title: Kutaa kana keessatti barsiisaan eenyu?
z-k-01-02.goal: Of-beeksisa gabaabaa irraa barsiisaa eenyu akka ta'e xiqqeessi, yeroo hima haaraan deebii kee waliin wal-faallessu hubadhu, fi wal-faallessuu sana sirreessu hima barreessi.
z-k-01-02.material: Namoonni sadii kutaa Koriyaa keessa jiru: 민호, 에밀리 fi 켄. Tokko isaanii barsiisaa dha; lamaan kaan barattoota. Nama tokko tokkoon lammummaa tokko qofa qaba (한국 사람 = Koriyaa, 미국 사람 = Ameerikaa). Nama hundi mallattoo lamaan duraa keessatti dhugaa dubbata. Mallattoon tokko tokkoon dhufa.
z-k-01-02.thinking.2: Mallattoo hundi dhugaa ta'uu hin dandeenye hojjechuu
z-k-01-02.prereq.2: Jechoota 학생, 선생님, 한국 사람, 미국 사람 ni beeka
z-k-01-02.s.s1.prompt: Mallattoo tokko tokkoo booda, yaada madaalamaa filadhu.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.hint.0: Osoo hin filatin dura, jechoota mataa keetiin hima tokko tokkoon maal akka dabalu moo baasu jedhi.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.hint.1: Mallattoo haaraa tokko tokkoo booda, wanta duraanuu beektu hundumaa waliin simata moo hin simanne mirkaneessi.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.after: 아니에요 에밀리 qofa baasa. 민호 fi 켄 lamaanuu amma illee ni danda'amu.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Hin ta'u' tokko nama tokko baasa fi kaan banaa dhiisa hubata.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: '에밀리 miti' akka '켄 ta'uu qaba' godha, 민호 waa'ee homaa hin jedhamne yoo ta'e illee.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Barsiisaan Koriyaa dha, 켄 Ameerikaa dha fi 에밀리 barsiisaa miti jette, kanaaf 민호 hafa.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 켄 barsiisaan Koriyaa dha jedha garuu inni Ameerikaa dha jedhu dhiisa.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Mallattoo 1 (에밀리 miti) fi mallattoo 2 (barsiisaan Koriyaa dha, 켄 Ameerikaa dha) walitti kaa'a.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Amma wanta baay'ee madaalamaa gochuu maali?
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Nama hundi dhugaa yoo dubbate, nama tokko illee barsiisaa ta'uu hin danda'u: 에밀리 miti, 켄 Koriyaa miti, fi 민호 barataa dha jedha. Kanaaf hima tokko dogoggora ykn dogoggoraan hubatame. Irra deebi'ee gaafachuu, ykn 민호 amantaa xiqqaadhaan qabachuu lamaanuu sirrii dha; mallattoo dhiisuun miti.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 민호 akka tilmaama koo gaarii qabadhu, garuu irra deebi'ii gaafadhu.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Deebii isa gaarii qaba garuu amantaa gadi buusa fi madda mirkaneessa.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Mallattoowwan hundi dhugaa ta'uu hin danda'an. Nama tokko tokkoon maal akka jedhe mirkaneessa.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Himoonni afran wal-faallessu hubata, kanaaf hima tokko dogoggora ykn dogoggoraan hubatame ta'uu qaba.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 켄 barsiisaa dha. Lammummaan isaa hin dhimmu.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.reflect: Mallattoon jalqabaa nama tokko baase, lammaffaan nama tokko filate, fi sadaffaan filannoo faallesse. Wal-faallessuun mallattoo gidduu odeeffannoo illee dha: deebii ati jaallattu filachuu mannaa himoota mirkaneessuu si hima.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.prompt: Hima Koriyaa tokko 민호 '저는 학생이에요' mannaa jechuu danda'u barreessi akka mallattoon hundi wal simatu fi inni barsiisaa ta'u.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.hint.0: Jechi kamtu hima 민호 dhumaa keessa jiru mallattoo kaan waliin wal-faallessa?
z-k-01-02.s.s2.hint.1: Jecha sana qofa bakka buusi fi xumura 이에요 eegi.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Amma illee 민호 Koriyaa ta'uu fi mallattoo kaan waliin simataa?
z-k-01-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Lammummaa isaa irra deebi'a, ergasii dhugaa haaraa.

z-k-01-11.title: Beeksisa dubbisa lama qabu
z-k-01-11.goal: Beeksisni dhugaa jedhu hiika lamaan jala argadhu, dhugaan yeroo dhufu ilaalcha kee haaromsi, lakkoofsa argamuu wal-simatu argadhu, beeksisa deebi'ii barreessi hiika tokko qofa akka hafu.
z-k-01-11.material:
Garee tokko miseensa 10 qaba (pirezidaantii garee 회장 miseensa 10 keessaa tokko). Seerri garee (Afaan Ingiliffaatiin): wal-gahii kan geggeeffamu xiqqaate 6 kan miseensota 10 yoo dhufan qofa. Beeksisni guyyaa wal-gahii booda maxxanfame:
“오늘 회의에는 회원이 모두 참석하지 않았습니다.”
Himni kun hiika lamaan dubbifamuu danda'a. Dubbisa A: miseensi tokkollee hin dhufne. Dubbisa B: miseensonni hundi hin dhufne (tokko tokko dhufan, tokko tokko hin dhufne). Dhugaan tokko tokkoon dhufa.
z-k-01-11.thinking.1: Xumura nageenya qabu eeguu fi dhugaa wajjin xiqqeessuu
z-k-01-11.prereq.0: 모두 (hundumaa) fi 아무도 / 한 명도 (nama tokkollee) beeka
z-k-01-11.prereq.1: Diddaa -지 않다 fi bocaa idilee -습니다 beeka
z-k-01-11.s.s1.prompt: Odeeffannoo tokkoon tokkoon booda yaada hubannoo qabu filadhu.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.hint.0: Dubbisa A keessatti maal dhugaa fi dubbisa B keessatti maal dhugaa gaafadhu, achiis lamaanuu keessatti dhugaa ta'e qofa eegi.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.hint.1: Dhugaa tokkoon tokkoon booda, dubbisa kam akka faallessu ilaali.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.info: Beeksisni armaan olii wanta ati beektu hundumaa dha.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.after: A jala hundi hin dhufne, B jala tokko tokko hin dhufne, kanaaf 'miseensi xiqqaate tokko hin dhufne' lamaan keessattis dhugaa dha. Wanti biraa ammas hin mirkanoofne.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Dubbisa A akka isa tokkoo qofa filata.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wanta dubbisni lamaan qooddatan argata: A fi B lamaanuu nama tokko dhiisu.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Hundi walii gala pirezidaantii (회장) wal-gahii irra ture.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.after: Pirezidaantiin yoo dhufe, 'miseensi tokkollee hin dhufne' soba. Dubbisa B, 'tokko tokko dhufan, tokko tokko hin dhufne', hafa.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Dubbisa B: tokko tokko dhufan tokko tokko hin dhufne.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Pirezidaantiin asii argamuun B wajjin wal-simata, kanaaf B hin haqamne.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Dubbisa A: miseensi tokkollee hin dhufne.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Dhugaa miseensi tokko dhufe fayyadama 'nama tokkollee hin dhufne' haquuf.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.info: 회의는 열리지 못했습니다. (Wal-gahiin geggeeffamuu hin dandeenye.)
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: Seera garee fayyadamuun miseensi meeqa dhufe?
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Xiqqaate 1 dhufe (pirezidaantii) fi 6 gad (kanaa achi wal-gahiin geggeeffamuu danda'a ture), kanaaf 1 hanga 5.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.reflect: Deebiin jalqabaa nageenya qaba sababni lamaan dubbisaa keessattis dhugaa ture. Dhugaan haaraan tokkoon tokkoon carraa tokko balleesse, si caalaatti sirrii akka taatu dandeessise. Dubbisa barreessaa tilmaamuun waan mirkanaa'e jechuuf si hin barbaachisne.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.prompt: Lakkoofsa argamuu danda'amu lama dhugaa sadanuu guutan kenni: miseensonni x dhufan, y hin dhufne (miseensa 10 waliigala). Lakkoofsi lamaan gatii x adda addaa qabaachuu qaba.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.hint.0: Lakkoofsa gad aanaa fi guddaa dhugaan hayyamu irraa jalqabi.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.ok.c2: x fi y miseensa 10 waliigala ta'u.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.ok.c4: Gad 6 dhufan, kanaaf wal-gahiin geggeeffamuu hin dandeenye.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.fail.c4: 6 ykn isaa ol wal-gahii geggeessuuf gahaa ture.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.explain: x kamiyyuu 1 hanga 5 ni hojjeta (y = 10 - x wajjin). 0 haqameera sababni pirezidaantiin dhufeef, 6 fi isaa ol haqameera sababni wal-gahiin hin geggeeffamneef.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.prompt: Beeksisa Afaan Koreaatiin al lama deebi'ii barreessi: hima 'miseensi tokkollee hin dhufne' qofa jechuu danda'u tokko, fi 'hundi hin dhufne' qofa jechuu danda'u tokko.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.hint.0: 'Nama tokkollee' jechuuf, jecha 'tokkollee hin' jechuu fayyadami.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.hint.1: 'Hundi miti' jechuuf, eenyutu dhufe himi ykn 'hundi dhufe miti' jedhi.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Himni koo jalqabaa nama tokkollee hin dhufne qofa jechuu?
z-k-01-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Himni koo lammaffaa tokko tokko hin dhufne qofa jechuu?
z-k-01-11.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Dubbisaan tokkoon isaanii irratti ammas shakkuu danda'aa?

z-k-01-04.title: Bakki dhaabbii kam 'bakka dhaabbii sadaffaa' dha?
z-k-01-04.topic: Karaa kennuu fi hordofuu sarara geejjiba lafa jala irra
z-k-01-04.goal: Karaan hiriyaa maal banaa akka dhiisu murteessi, ergaa haaraa fayyadamuun danda'amoo xiqqeessi, fi gaaffii dhugaa hanqate Afaan Koriyaatiin gaafadhu.
z-k-01-04.material:
민아 geejjiba lafa jalaatiin mana barumsaa 지우 deemaa jirti. Sarara 2 bakka dhaabbii kana tartiibaan, bitaa irraa gara mirgaatti, dhaabata:
가역 - 나역 - 다역 - 라역 - 마역 - 바역 - 사역
Mana 민아 라역 bira jira, kanaaf 라역 irratti seenti. 지우 ergaa lama ergiti. Isaan tokko tokkoon dhufu.
z-k-01-04.prereq.0: 타세요 / 내리세요 fi 세 번째 ni beeka
z-k-01-04.prereq.1: 쪽 (kallattii) fi 앞 (fuula dura) ni beeka
z-k-01-04.prereq.2: Tarree bakka dhaabbii tartiibaan jiru dubbisuu ni danda'a
z-k-01-04.s.s1.prompt: Ergaa tokko tokkoo booda, yaada madaalamaa filadhu.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bakka dhaabbii sararaa irratti barreessi fi 라역 mallatteessi. Bakka dhaabbii sadaffaatti gama lamaan irraa lakkaa'i.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.hint.1: Osoo hin filatin dura, 지우 bakka dhaabbii tokko qofa danda'amu godhuuf maal dabaluu qaba gaafadhu.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: 민아 eessatti bu'uu akka qabdu mirkanaa'uu dandeessaa?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 라역 mataan isaa yoo hin lakkaa'amne, bakka dhaabbii sadaffaa bitaan 가역 fi mirgaan 사역 dha. Kallattiin hin jiru.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Eyyee: 'bakka dhaabbii sadaffaa' bakka dhaabbii tokko qofa maqaa moggaasa.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kallattii tokko qofa lakkaa'a fi sararri gama lamaan deema dhiisa.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Lakkii: ergaan karaa kamiin deemuu qabdu hin jedhu.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Bakka dhaabbii sadaffaa bitaa fi mirga bakka dhaabbii adda akka ta'e arga.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Lakkii: ergaan imalli daqiiqaa meeqa akka fudhatu hin jedhu.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Bakka dhaabbii sadaffaa hin jijjiirre bal'ina barbaada.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: 민아, kan 라역 irratti seente, tiif bakka dhaabbiin sadaffaan kam?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Dubbattoonni baay'een bakka seenan hin lakkaa'an, kunis 사역 kenna; tokko tokko ni lakkaa'u, kunis 바역 kenna. 사역 filachuun tilmaama gaarii dha, fi mirkanaa'uu dhabuun illee madaalamaa dha. Tarkaanfiin isa nageenya qabu gaafachuu dha.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Bakka dhaabbii isheen seente booda itti aanu irraa lakkaa'uu jalqaba.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Bakka dhaabbii seenuu akka isa jalqabaa lakkaa'a.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mirkanaa'uu hin danda'u: 라역 mataan isaa lakkaa'amuu moo hin lakkaa'amne irratti hundaa'a.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Karaa lakkaa'uu lama jiraachuu fi tokko illee hin himamne arga.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kun akkamitti 지우 akka lakkaa'e maal siif hima?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Mana barumsaa 사역 irra jira. 마역 (1), 바역 (2), 사역 (3) lakkaa'uun qofa achi ga'a, kanaaf 지우 bakka seenuu hin lakkaa'in.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 지우 라역 akka isa jalqabaa lakkaa'e.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Akkas yoo ta'e, bakka dhaabbii sadaffaa 바역 ta'a ture, bakka dhaabbii mana barumsaa miti.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Iddoon mana barumsaa waa'ee lakkaa'uu homaa hin jedhu.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Bakki dhaabbii mana barumsaa lakkaa'uun kamtu dhaabbii sirrii argachuu agarsiisa.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 지우 라역, bakka itti seentu, hin lakkaa'in.

z-k-01-12.title: Walitti hidhaan gara dogoggoraa agarsiisu
z-k-01-12.topic: Walitti hidhaa sababaa fi faallaa cuunfaa oduu keessatti
z-k-01-12.goal: Hima cuunfaa walitti hidhaan gabaasa caalaa jedhu argadhu, walitti hidhaa kan hin jenne filadhu, hima faallaa ofii kee barreessi.
z-k-01-12.material:
Gabaasni oduu dhugaa kana kenna (hundumaa dhugaa):
① 학교가 급식 시간을 20분에서 30분으로 늘렸다.
② 줄 서는 시간이 평균 12분에서 7분으로 줄었다. 보도는 급식 시간 연장이 그 이유라고 밝혔다 (gabaasni yeroo laaqanaa dheeraa sababa ta'e jedha).
③ 학생 만족도는 62%에서 55%로 낮아졌다. 보도는 그 이유를 밝히지 않았다 (gabaasni kanaaf sababa hin kennu).

Barataan tokko gabaasa cuunfata:
1. 학교는 급식 시간을 20분에서 30분으로 늘렸다.
2. 그래서 줄 서는 시간이 평균 12분에서 7분으로 줄었다.
3. 그래서 학생 만족도는 62%에서 55%로 낮아졌다.
4. 이처럼 급식 시간을 늘렸지만 학생 만족도는 오르지 않았다.
